lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Listen, point and say

details: Listen, Point and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for accurate pointing to the characters (e.g., pointing to the police officer on the podium, or the doctor walking) and clear repetition of the job titles.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Ask and answer with What's missing?

details: Ask and answer with What's missing? develops visual memory and vocabulary recall. Students play a game where they identify which professional has been covered or removed from the sequence.
Look for quick identification of the missing job and confident production of the word (e.g., "The vet is missing!").

Match develops early literacy skills by linking the written word to the visual representation. Students draw lines connecting the job title in the box to the correct character illustration.
Look for logical connections: 'vet' to the person with the cat, 'chef' to the person with the hat/spoon, 'teacher' to the book, 'doctor' to the stethoscope.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Say the chant.

details: Say the chant consolidates the new vocabulary through rhythm. Students chant the names of the jobs to practise pronunciation and memorise the list.
Look for enthusiastic participation, clapping to the rhythm, and distinct pronunciation of multi-syllable words.
